description.value: Chicken World is a Canadian fast-food chain with a Victoria location on Pandora Avenue, specializing in fried and peri peri chicken with South Asian-inspired spice blends. The menu extends well beyond chicken to include burgers, wraps, poutine, and sides, with online ordering and delivery alongside dine-in service. Cyclists stopping here will find a broad, filling menu with quick-service options in a central Victoria location.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (10 spaces) at 44m. Total: 10 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Victoria location at 924 Pandora Ave with phone 250-363-9800, matching the OSM record exactly. The about-us page states customers can dine in, use the drive-thru, or have food delivered, and a Veggie Burger appears on the burgers menu page. No website content addresses bike parking, water refills, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities, so all required criteria remain unconfirmed.
concerns: Website footer displays '© 2027 Chicken World', a future copyright year relative to current date (2026-05-27) — minor website anomaly.
Chain restaurant with multiple BC and Alberta locations; this OSM record is specifically for the Victoria (924 Pandora Ave) location only.
